source_refs.note: Exercise 12.3, Question 7 (i)-(ii): inflation I(t) = I0 e^(0.03t) (book p.236); 'inflation rate' in (i) is the total rise over 5 years. Answer key PDF 310: 16.18%, 134.99.

blocks.prompt: 7 (i) Inflation is modeled by \(I(t) = I_0 e^{0.03t}\), where \(I_0\) is the initial price index and \(t\) is the number of years. Find the inflation rate after 5 years if \(I_0 = 100\).
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein mehngai (inflation) ka model hai. "Inflation rate after 5 years" se yahan murad hai ke 5 saal mein price index kitne percent barha (answer key bhi 16.18% deti hai). Formula mein saalana continuous rate to 3% hi hai.
Plan: pehle \(I(5)\) nikalein, phir 100 ke muqable mein percentage increase nikalein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(I(t) = I_0 e^{0.03t}\), \(I_0 = 100\), \(t = 5\).
Humein find karna hai: 5 saal mein price index ka percentage izafa (inflation).
Tareeqa: \(I(5)\) nikalein, phir percentage increase \(= \dfrac{\text{naya} - \text{purana}}{\text{purana}} \times 100\%\).

\(I(5)\) nikalein
\[I(5) = 100e^{0.03 \times 5}\]
\[= 100e^{0.15}\]
\[\approx 100 \times 1.16183 = 116.18\]
Kyun: \(t = 5\) rakha to power \(0.03 \times 5 = 0.15\) bani. Calculator se \(e^{0.15} \approx 1.16183\). 100 se multiply karne par 116.18.

Percentage increase
\[\frac{116.18 - 100}{100} \times 100\%\]
\[= 16.18\%\]
Kyun: Index 100 se 116.18 hua, yani 16.18 points barha, aur base 100 hai, is liye izafa 16.18%.
Dhyan dein: \(5 \times 3\% = 15\%\) likh dena ghalti hai. Continuous growth mein har saal ka izafa pichle izafe par bhi lagta hai, is liye jawab 15% se thora zyada aata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[100 \times 1.1618 = 116.18\]
Kyun: 100 par 16.18% barhane se wapas \(I(5)\) mil jata hai. Yani 5 saal mein jo cheez 100 rupay ki thi woh taqreeban 116.18 rupay ki ho gayi. Rozmarra misaal: aaj jo bag 1000 rupay ka hai, is model ke mutabiq 5 saal baad taqreeban 1162 rupay ka hoga.

blocks.prompt: 7 (ii) Inflation is modeled by \(I(t) = I_0 e^{0.03t}\), where \(I_0\) is the initial price index and \(t\) is the number of years. What is the expected price index after 10 years?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi value nikalne ka sawal hai: 10 saal baad price index. \(I_0 = 100\) part (i) se hi liya jayega.
Plan: \(t = 10\) rakhein aur calculator se \(e^{0.3}\) nikalein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(I(t) = I_0 e^{0.03t}\), \(I_0 = 100\) (part (i) se).
Humein find karna hai: \(I(10)\).
Tareeqa: \(t\) ki jagah 10 rakhenge.

Power nikalein
\[0.03 \times 10 = 0.3\]
\[I(10) = 100e^{0.3}\]
Kyun: Pehle power ka hisaab, phir \(e\) ki value; is tarah ghalti ka imkaan kam hota hai.

Value nikalein
\[e^{0.3} \approx 1.34986\]
\[I(10) \approx 100 \times 1.34986\]
\[\approx 134.99\]
Kyun: Calculator ke \(e^x\) button se \(e^{0.3} \approx 1.34986\), phir 100 se multiply. Do decimal tak round kiya. Matlab: 10 saal mein qeematein taqreeban 35% barh jati hain.
Dhyan dein: Calculator mein pehle 0.3 likh kar \(e^x\) dabayein (ya model ke hisaab se \(e^{(0.3)}\)); \(e \times 0.3\) mat karein.

Tasdeeq
\[\frac{I(10)}{I(5)} \approx \frac{134.99}{116.18} \approx 1.162\]
Kyun: Har 5 saal mein index ek hi factor \(e^{0.15} \approx 1.1618\) se multiply hota hai. Exponential growth ki yahi pehchaan hai, is liye dono jawab aapas mein mel khate hain.
